ch01_intro.speaker: Aldric
ch01_intro.text: The ruins road is the only way north. Stay close and watch the trees.

ch01_chests.speaker: Corin
ch01_chests.text: Old supply chests! Raiders will strip them soon — grab what you can.

ch01_looted.speaker: Brina
ch01_looted.text: Too late — the raiders cleared out the last chests.

ch02_intro.speaker: Fiora
ch02_intro.text: Wolves have Millford surrounded. The miller's still in his house!

ch02_villager.speaker: Villager
ch02_villager.text: Help! I'll keep away from them as best I can!

ch02_wolves.speaker: Eamon
ch02_wolves.text: More howling from the hills — the pack is growing!

ch02_villager_down.speaker: Aldric
ch02_villager_down.text: No... we were too slow. Fall back!

ch03_intro.speaker: Garret
ch03_intro.text: That camp belongs to the Goblin Chief. Take him and the raids stop.

chief_intro.speaker: Goblin Chief
chief_intro.text: Little soldiers, marching into my camp? Come closer.

chief_phase2.speaker: Goblin Chief
chief_phase2.text: Enough! Guards, to me — I'll crush them myself!

join_aldric.speaker: Aldric
join_aldric.text: Captain of the border watch. I don't leave anyone behind.

join_brina.speaker: Brina
join_brina.text: Shield up, spear out. I'll hold the line.

join_corin.speaker: Corin
join_corin.text: I can hit a crow at sixty paces. Goblins are bigger than crows.

join_dara.speaker: Dara
join_dara.text: Try not to get hurt. But if you do, I'm here.

join_eamon.speaker: Eamon
join_eamon.text: I studied fire for six years. Finally, something to burn.

join_fiora.speaker: Fiora
join_fiora.text: Millford is my home. I'll fight beside you to keep it.

join_garret.speaker: Garret
join_garret.text: Woodcutter by trade. This axe has felled bigger things than goblins.

join_hale.speaker: Hale
join_hale.text: I've tracked that chief for a month. Let's finish it.

camp_aldric_ch01.speaker: Aldric
camp_aldric_ch01.text: First march together. Keep the archers behind Brina.

camp_brina_ch01.speaker: Brina
camp_brina_ch01.text: Hills slow me down, but nothing gets past me on flat ground.

camp_corin_ch01.speaker: Corin
camp_corin_ch01.text: If you see a chest, shout. I'll cover you.

camp_dara_ch01.speaker: Dara
camp_dara_ch01.text: Stand next to each other in battle. Friends fight better together.

camp_aldric_ch02.speaker: Aldric
camp_aldric_ch02.text: The villager comes first. We can always fight another wolf.

camp_eamon_ch02.speaker: Eamon
camp_eamon_ch02.text: Wolves hate fire. Point me at the pack.

camp_fiora_ch02.speaker: Fiora
camp_fiora_ch02.text: I know these streets. The wolves don't.

camp_dara_ch02.speaker: Dara
camp_dara_ch02.text: Herbs are cheap. Buy a few before we go.

camp_aldric_ch03.speaker: Aldric
camp_aldric_ch03.text: The chief won't move until he's hurt. Strike together, then hold.

camp_garret_ch03.speaker: Garret
camp_garret_ch03.text: Bandits ride with him. Mind the axes.

camp_hale_ch03.speaker: Hale
camp_hale_ch03.text: When he charges, he'll call his guards. Be ready.

camp_brina_ch03.speaker: Brina
camp_brina_ch03.text: Promotion would suit me. Ten more battles, maybe.

town_elder.speaker: Elder
town_elder.text: The ruins road was a king's highway once. Now only raiders use it.

town_smith.speaker: Smith
town_smith.text: A good spear outlasts three swords. Tell your knight I said so.

town_mayor.speaker: Mayor
town_mayor.text: Thank you for coming. The wolves grow bolder every night.

town_child.speaker: Child
town_child.text: My brother hid his bow behind the mill. Don't tell him I told you!

town_hunter.speaker: Hunter
town_hunter.text: Wolves run fast but bite weak. Archers on high ground do well.
